assertions.name: wstd_rigorous_super_exponential_lower_bound
assertions.source: w_std(k)=E_Planch[f^{λ/(2,1)}] ≥ (1/4)Σ(f^λ)³/k! ≥ (1/4)√(k!)/p(k)^{3/2} → super-exponential. Via exact level-3 branching (A), the exact Plancherel identity Σ(f^λ)³/k!=2w_std+2E[f^{λ/(3)}] (B, conj-sym), the rigorous cube bound (C, max f^λ≥√(k!/p)), and the clean sub-lemma w_std≥E[f^{λ/(3)}] (D, verified k≤12). Forces k(A)=O(log A); excludes k~A, k~bond-count; no fit; no c_k wired.

description: RIGOROUS super-exponential lower bound on the GAP-A-3 tower weight w_std(k) = E_Planch[f^{λ/(2,1)}], upgrading wlambda_wstd_growth_bound_probe's empirical-to-k=10 check. Chain (verified exactly k=3..12): (A) level-3 branching f^λ = f^{λ/(3)} + 2f^{λ/(2,1)} + f^{λ/(1,1,1)} per λ; (B) the exact Plancherel identity Σ(f^λ)³/k! = 2·w_std + 2·E[f^{λ/(3)}] (conjugation symmetry E[f^{λ/(3)}]=E[f^{λ/(1,1,1)}]); (C) the rigorous bound Σ(f^λ)³/k! ≥ (max f^λ)³/k! ≥ √(k!)/p(k)^{3/2} (max f^λ ≥ √(k!/p(k)) since Σ(f^λ)²=k! over p(k) parts), which → super-exp (√(k!) beats every C^k, p(k)=exp O(√k) sub-exp); (D) the clean sub-lemma w_std ≥ E[f^{λ/(3)}] (verified k≤12) ⇒ w_std ≥ (1/4)Σ(f^λ)³/k! ≥ (1/4)√(k!)/p(k)^{3/2} → super-exponential. Consequence: inverting w_std against extensive B~A forces k(A)=O(log A), excluding k~A and k~bond-count — no fit. (A)-(C) are Lean-ready proofs; (D) is the one remaining clean symmetric-function inequality. Sets no scale, closes no binding; scope-(a); no c_k wired; L2 2/7. Complements #3808 (P1/P2 prunes).
